mapper.select: SELECT pet_seq, user_seq, pet_name, pet_type, pet_age, pet_image, created_at, updated_at FROM pet WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq} ORDER BY pet_seq DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet ( user_seq, pet_name, pet_type, gender, birth_date, pet_age, pet_image, memo ) VALUES ( #{userSeq}, #{petName}, #{petType}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{petAge}, #{petImage}, #{memo} )
